title: model-eol repository configuration
description: Optional strict .model-eol.json configuration shared by the zero-dependency CLI, Action, and GitHub bot adapter.

days.description: Open migration work for models retiring within this many days.

scope.description: Use the direct-first scope (direct API plus generic model references, leaving cloud/gateway references as hints), or include all tracked references.

via.description: Optional distributor lifecycle clock, such as azure-ai-foundry.

allow_vendored_fallback.description: Continue with vendored feeds after a remote feed failure in degraded report-only mode.

models.description: Canonical IDs or aliases to ignore across CLI, Action, and bot. Either form ignores every alias of the canonical feed entry.

paths.description: Repo-relative simple globs supporting *, **, and ?. Matching paths are excluded before file coverage checks where possible.

enabled.description: Maintain GitHub issues for non-patchable actionable findings.

command.description: Opt-in evaluation command. Direct bot --eval runs it per changed patch in a temporary clone; the split example workflow runs it once as a read-only plan preflight.

pass_env.description: Environment variable names explicitly passed to the eval command.
